Page 110 Cont.
Feb. 7 Sarah McEachin - 63 - fell two weeks ago and broke hip - now pneumonia in receiving Hospital
Mrs. John McHugh - 72 - liver-cancer unconscious ... speedy recovery or grace of Happy death.
Ellen Furlong - 78 - Sight-failing - spry and active but ...
Lucile Salatke - 11 - Sarcoma - blood cancer ... in bed about a yr. Mary Dewey - 18 - paralysis - whole side .... very cross.
Page 111
Feb. 11th Rosemary Morrissey - 12 - of Chicago here To-day with eyes very defect- ive sight. Drs. say "only supernatural help will avail anything".
Mary Carney - 39 - of Chicago - arthritis - and scrupulousty .... Sophie Druszkowski - 21 - goitre .. second operation expected next Wed. Rolf Herold - 24 - Lutheran, swallowed some kind of lie when about three - has had trouble ever since in swallowing.
Xavier Jos. Fish - 31 - bitten by a pet cat 15 yrs. ago. Now fears something like blood-poison. Drs. say a part of the bone of hand must be removed ... Enrolled To-night - promising more frequent communion and perpet Enrollment if .. ..
12 Mary (Mrs) Lannigan - 32 - Mother of three healthy children. A fourth Bn dead full-time but quite decayed. Enrolled last Thursday when hope- lessly full of pertenitis: Friday out of danger - Home To-day and normal. Deo. Gr .!
Page 112 Feb. 12 Bertram W. Regner - 58 - had ear hemorages and since - now two weeks can hear 0
Jeanette Fr. Mangen -- lost purse with all she had $1.11 - Rosary etc. - snatched from arm.
Skippey Fahey % two telegram sick in Ford Hospital - little child Jos. Toohey - 15 (?) of Lucon, Ont. - takes fits almost every day ...
